skills.name: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
skills.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
skills.growth_data_status: no historical candidate snapshot in 7-day/30-day comparison windows
skills.heat_data_status: GitHub cumulative Stars plus exact-match Hacker News discussions; Stars growth not available
skills.compatibility_status: 文档及仓库元数据已核验；未执行安装测试
skills.rare_value_reason: Distinct documented capability: security + audit; actual SKILL.md files, README and license verified. This is a use-case distinction, not a claim of global uniqueness.

scoring_model.growth_data_policy: 7-day and 30-day Stars deltas are populated only when a dated snapshot of the same canonical repository exists in the permitted comparison window; otherwise null. Current run records a daily candidate snapshot.

limitations: Only accessible archived recommendation days can be checked; incomplete 90-day coverage is explicitly reported.
Repository metadata and README were checked; installation and dedicated security audits were not performed.

method.news_sources: public RSS feeds; links and published timestamps preserved
method.china_ai_news_sources: QbitAI, Machine Heart, GeekPark, 36Kr, Leiphone AI/robotics/chips, iFanr, AIquanbao, TechNode, TechCrunch AI and Google News China-AI RSS; filtered for China-related AI entities and timestamps within seven days
method.skill_ranking: evidence-verified GitHub repositories ranked by weighted heat, trend relevance, practical usefulness, technical quality, novelty and maintenance; current cumulative Stars are not treated as historical growth
